question: On the frozen ETH 15m V12.10 VIDYA-gated serial entries, does exiting at the next 15m open after a confirmed VIDYA state flip reduce loss streak and drawdown without sacrificing net R versus the unchanged V12.10 exit?
single_variable: Exit rule only. Keep the V12.10 admission gate, entry signal, next-open fill, initial stop, trailing stop, raw opposite-signal exit, serial occupancy, and 0.2% round-trip cost frozen. If a completed 15m bar shows the latched VIDYA state opposite to the open position, schedule an exit at the following 15m open. An active stop gap at that open retains priority; stop touches during the completed bar are processed before the close-confirmed VIDYA flip.

execution.control: one deterministic same-state random entry per admitted trade, matched on side, UTC week, fold, and causal ATR/close bin; apply the same exit policy and costs

vidya.parameters: length 10, momentum 20, SMA 15, ATR 200, band distance 2.0
vidya.exit_trigger: confirmed latched direction state is opposite to position side at the 15m close

notes: Research-only exit overlay requested by owner on 2026-10-12.
The primary comparison is the same V12.10 admission strategy with the original exit versus this single added VIDYA-flip exit.
No thresholds are tuned; no Pine, monitor, preset, active bundle, account, or live execution behavior is changed.
